Package io.webagent4j.crawler.api

package io.webagent4j.crawler.api
Backend-neutral HTTP crawler contracts - depends only on webagent4j-common: no HTTP client, no HTML parser, no Playwright.

CrawlRequest is immutable and fully validated at construction; ICrawler.crawl(CrawlRequest) is the entire public surface an engine implements (currently only HttpCrawler in webagent4j-crawler). CrawlResult carries CrawledPages, structured CrawlFailures, CrawlStatistics, and a CrawlTerminationReason - no field of CrawlStatistics is defined in terms of another; each has its own independent, precise definition (see its own class documentation).

IUrlNormalizer, ICrawlScopePolicy, and ICrawlDeduplicator are the extension points a custom engine or policy would implement. This module cannot depend on Playwright, any browser backend, or an AI/LLM library. See docs/http-crawler.md for the full traversal pipeline, redirect/retry semantics, and the determinism contract.

    Description
    io.webagent4j.crawler
    The deterministic, sequential HTTP crawler engine: a java.net.http.HttpClient fetcher, jsoup link extraction, a breadth-first frontier, URL normalization/deduplication/scope policy, and redirect/retry handling - no browser, no JavaScript execution.
    io.webagent4j.crawler.api.internal
    Shared validation internals for the crawler API and its webagent4j-crawler implementation - currently just HttpHeaderValidation, the one framework-owned definition of a valid caller-supplied crawler HTTP header.

  • Class
    Description
    CrawlDecision
    Immutable outcome of evaluating one candidate URL against crawl scope/policy: either CrawlDecisionType.ALLOW, or a specific rejection type with a human-readable reason - never a bare boolean a caller would have to reverse-engineer.
    CrawlDecisionType
    Every possible outcome of deciding whether a candidate URL enters the crawl frontier.
    CrawledPage
    Immutable representation of one HTML page successfully fetched during a crawl.
    CrawlFailure
    Immutable, structured record of one URL's fetch attempt failing terminally - never a plain null or a silently-dropped entry.
    CrawlFailureType
    Distinct, diagnosable reasons a fetch attempt failed to produce a CrawledPage.
    CrawlPageProvenance
    Where one CrawledPage came from: enough to reconstruct the discovery chain from a seed to this page without retaining the whole crawl's discovery graph.
    CrawlRequest
    Immutable, fully-validated configuration for one ICrawler.crawl(CrawlRequest) call.
    CrawlRequest.Builder
    Mutable, incrementally-built CrawlRequest factory.
    CrawlResult
    Immutable outcome of one ICrawler.crawl(CrawlRequest) call.
    CrawlStatistics
    Immutable crawl-wide counters.
    CrawlTerminationReason
    Why a CrawlResult's crawl loop stopped.
    DiscoveredLink
    One navigation link found on a crawled page, before or after the crawl scope/policy decision - used both to populate the frontier and to explain, in CrawlResult.rejectedUrls(), why a particular URL was never fetched.
    ICrawlDeduplicator
    Tracks which normalized URLs have already been discovered during one crawl, so the same URL is never fetched twice.
    ICrawler
    Backend-neutral crawler contract.
    ICrawlScopePolicy
    Decides whether a candidate URL discovered on one page may enter the crawl frontier: scheme, host/domain, and URL-filter rules.
    IUrlNormalizer
    Deterministically normalizes an absolute URL into the identity used for deduplication.
    LinkKind
    Which HTML element produced a DiscoveredLink.
    QueryParameterPolicy
    Deterministic policy for which URL query parameters survive normalization.
    QueryParameterPolicy.QueryParameterMode
    The base rule QueryParameterPolicy applies before per-parameter overrides.
    RedirectHop
    One HTTP redirect hop observed while resolving a single fetch attempt.
    TraversalStrategy
    Order in which the frontier releases discovered URLs for fetching.
